text:
Eve (Infra PM): Heads-up — we’re rolling out a limited preview of A10G+ dedicated pools in sg1 (Singapore) next week for Reserved customers. Preview window: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30. Capacity initially: 24 GPUs across 3 zones. Pricing: same as A10G with a 10% discount on sustained committed usage.
Rohan (Eng-Infra): tagging infra/ops — we’ve added a new scheduler flavor `a10gplus-highmem` and a quota tag `a10gplus-preview`. Pools will be visible in the console under Dedicated -> Preview pools.
Priya (SRE): Ops notes: no preemptible variant in preview. Network footprint is identical to A10G, but we’re enabling KV-cache-friendly PCIe tuning. Expect slightly higher memory pressure on some models.
Claire (Sales): heads-up to AE/CS — customers on annual reserved contracts can opt-in for a soft migration. Please use the intake form: https://redwood.internal/ops/forms/a10gplus-intake
Jin (Docs): PR landed for docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/a10g-plus-preview — includes migration steps and rollout FAQ. Please review before go-live.
Eve (Infra PM): Quick checklist —
- [ ] Release note in Console (visible flag)
- [ ] Billing rule: apply `a10gplus` sku mapping for committed usage
- [ ] Ops playbook updated (incident runbook + capacity limits)
Rohan (Eng-Infra): deploy-bot scheduled pool provisioning job: `provision a10gplus sg1` — ETA 03:00 UTC 2026-04-01. Will post logs in #release-war-room.
Priya (SRE): If you see model OOMs, add `--kv-cache-size 512MB` as a temp mitigation. Example:
```
redwood-cli run --pool a10gplus --model {model} --env REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=512MB
```
Claire (Sales): Any limit on Reserved customers during preview? Finance: yes — we’re limiting to customers with >= $10k/mo committed spend. Exceptions by request to Finance.
Eve (Infra PM): To request pool access internally: file the intake form and add `@Rohan` as reviewer. We’ll convert approved requests into console quota increases. :party:
ops-bot: Pool provisioning job started (job_id: 0x7f3c9). Logs: https://infra-logs.internal/jobs/0x7f3c9
Rohan (Eng-Infra): FYI — metrics will be under `dedicated.sg1.a10gplus.*` in Metrics; set your dashboards accordingly.
Eve (Infra PM): Anything else? Otherwise plan is to flip the preview flag at 03:00 UTC on 2026-04-01.
Priya (SRE): All good from oncall side. Will monitor 24h post flip.
Claire (Sales): thumbs up from GTM.
Eve (Infra PM): Thanks — will post a formal announcement after provisioning completes. :shipit:
